comment: AFTERBYTE editorial lifecycle policy v1. Hard rules: (1) a single HTTP failure, quiet repo, or absent post NEVER sets discontinued; (2) missing data is not negative evidence; (3) uncertain is the default when evidence is thin or conflicting.

app.insufficientAloneExample: a single failed HTTP request to the vendor's update server

community.insufficientAloneExample: one quiet week in a single channel

crypto_project.insufficientAloneExample: one failed transaction or a single missed weekly update

game.insufficientAloneExample: one month without a patch, or a single player report of server lag

meme.insufficientAloneExample: a single day without new posts

other.insufficientAloneExample: a single missing data point or one platform outage

website.insufficientAloneExample: a single 404 or a transient DNS failure

tieBreak: explicit closure beats all silence; multiple independent signal types beat one strong signal; recent (<=30d) evidence beats old (>180d); on a remaining tie, default to uncertain and flag for human review
